question: What caused the 12% drop in revenue on 2024-02-19?

steps.name: plan
steps.title: Plan: revenue on 2024-02-19
steps.detail: Pull daily revenue for 2024-02-19 and compare it with the same weekday in prior weeks to size the 12% drop. | Break revenue down by region, platform and channel to find which segments account for most of the decline. | Check whether sessions or conversion_rate fell, to separate a traffic loss from a checkout problem. | Review deploy changelog entries (CHG-...), GitHub issues (ISS-...) and support tickets (TKT-...) dated around 2024-02-19 for matching changes or incidents. | Rule out seasonality such as the weekend dip, and match the drop to one cause type before concluding.

steps: Pull daily revenue for 2024-02-19 and compare it with the same weekday in prior weeks to size the 12% drop.
Break revenue down by region, platform and channel to find which segments account for most of the decline.
Check whether sessions or conversion_rate fell, to separate a traffic loss from a checkout problem.
Review deploy changelog entries (CHG-...), GitHub issues (ISS-...) and support tickets (TKT-...) dated around 2024-02-19 for matching changes or incidents.
Rule out seasonality such as the weekend dip, and match the drop to one cause type before concluding.

steps.detail: revenue on 2024-02-19 (Monday) was 8.776e+05. The same weekday in the 6 weeks before had a median of 9.975e+05. Change vs that baseline: -12.0% (z = -8.5). Change vs the day before: +14.9%. This is unusual (|z| >= 3).

input.sql: SELECT date, SUM(sessions) AS sessions, SUM(orders) AS orders, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(orders)::float/NULLIF(SUM(sessions),0) AS conversion_rate, SUM(payment_failures)::float/NULLIF(SUM(payment_attempts),0) AS payment_failure_rate FROM daily_metrics WHERE region='na' AND date BETWEEN '2024-02-05' AND '2024-02-25' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

results.title: Spike in declined payments via Adyon (North America)

steps.name: investigate
steps.title: Finished investigating
steps.detail: The 12% revenue drop on 2024-02-19 was caused by a payment provider error in North America: the Adyon provider was declining valid cards, and the NA payment failure rate jumped from about 3% to 32%. NA sessions stayed normal (81.8k), but conversion fell from about 8.3% to 5.8%, which accounts for the NA revenue drop of -28.6%. Support tickets from NA customers on iOS and web report "declined" card

steps.title: Rank hypotheses
steps.detail: Adyon rejecting North American card payments on 2024-02-19

output.summary: Revenue on 2024-02-19 fell 12% versus the weekday baseline, and the drop was concentrated in North America (-28.6%). In North America, the payment failure rate jumped to about 32% while sessions stayed normal, and an issue reports declines through the Adyen provider. The most likely cause is a payment provider error in North America.

causes.title: Adyon rejecting North American card payments on 2024-02-19

claims.text: Revenue on 2024-02-19 was 12.0% below the same-weekday baseline, with a z-score of -8.5.
The revenue drop was concentrated in region na, which fell 28.6% versus baseline while the other regions moved by less than 3%.
In region na the payment failure rate rose to 31.7% on 2024-02-19 from about 3% on surrounding days, while sessions stayed near normal levels.
An issue reports a spike in declined payments through Adyon in North America, with banks saying the cards are fine and the provider rejecting them.
